Claim amendment · 2026-10-31T02:45Z · amends claim 6537960788 after the card thread's read-only pre-check on `origin/main` `6285203d`. Append-only.

File surface (replaces the claim's): the `kanban` branches of `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` and `ui/packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`; one shared helper in `@object-ui/core`; tests in those packages, plus a pin in `ui/packages/plugin-kanban`; the `packages/spec/liveness/view.json` `kanban` row only; a root changeset. Stop and explain on any breach.

Why: `ObjectKanban` never receives `kanban.lanes`. Both `object-kanban` producers forward only named block keys, and `ComponentPropsMap['object-kanban']` has no `lanes`. Adding one would be a spec edit, which the triage exception doesn't cover. So the producers map `kanban.lanes` onto the existing node key `columns` (`{ id, title }` in the author's order, the title taken from the option label, a `lost`-kind lane `collapsed: true` per #26612). An unlisted value still lands in `Uncategorized`, both when the client buckets values and when the lanes page, so nothing is hidden.

Clause-②: no (the seat's expectation; a new `@object-ui/core` export would move it to `yes (widening)`, and the dev measures it on the diff)

Riders: S2 doesn't ride (`checkKanbanLanes` is in `packages/lint`, outside the liveness file). The TSDoc on `KanbanConfigSchema.lanes` ("Lands ahead of its reader…") goes stale once this lands. That is a spec-source edit outside this card, and the seat files it, together with S2, as a `domain:spec` follow-up after this PR merges.
